variants.prompt: In an extreme close-up, her parted lips hover just inches from the lens, her emerald eyes sparkling with mischief and desire. The shallow depth of field blurs the rest of her face into a soft focus, emphasizing the plump curve of her lower lip and the delicate freckles dusting the bridge of her nose. A single strand of fiery hair falls across her cheek, the golden highlight adding warmth to the intimate, sensual shot.
